{{Otheruses|Graveyard}}
'''The Graveyard''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on [[Starlyte Station]]. Serving as both the home and workplace of the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Scizzic]], The Graveyard was filled with abandoned and wrecked [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Scizzic used the material in his work, modifying and upgrading starships for Starlyte Station's visitors. His work was expensive, but of a high-quality and always reliable.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
